answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so old endorsements lose weight and an identity must provide sustained honest service to retain influence. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned sybils have almost no trusted incoming mass; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot manufacture support from their own links, leaving their eigenvector centrality near zero. Thus labels such as quartz, plume, or marble cannot by themselves earn consensus.
